units.text:
Translation of long and
   difficult sentences


               Unit 2

• 1. Old enemies never die.
• 宿敌不死。
• 2. Those who cannot remember the past are doomed to
  repeat it.
• 不能铭记过去的人注定要重蹈覆辙
• 3. Close the book on infectious diseases.
• 给传染病画上句号了
• 4. Antibiotics and vaccines had left the medical
 community flush with a string of impressive victories,
 from penicillin to polio.
• 抗生素和疫苗带来了一个接一个了不起的胜利，从
 青霉素的发现到脊髓灰质炎的防治等凡此种种，让
 医学界欣喜不已。

• 5. Today, confronted with what have become known as
 emerging and re-emerging diseases, we know better.
• 今天，当我们面对各种已经被称为新现疾病和再现疾
 病时，我们（头脑更加清醒）认识更加透彻。
• 6. Tuberculosis---which never really went away, though
  upscale opera buffs might have thought it was confined to
  productions of La Boheme ---- is once again a threat in
  urban centers, including New York city.
• 虽然上层社会的歌剧迷们也许觉得结核病只见于《波
 西米亚人》这样的歌剧中，而事实上，结核病就从来
 没有消失过，再次成为包括纽约市在内的城市中心的
 威胁。
• 7. In fact, that sentiment may reflect as much hyperbole as
  the former Surgeon General.
• 事实上，那个（科学家的）观点可能和美国前卫生局
 局长威廉·斯图尔特的看法一样，都带有夸张之处。

• 8. With a crowded market place in Kikwit, Zaire,
  site of the last Ebola flare-up, less than 24 hours
 away from a New York City subway, borders are
 meaningless to pathogenic microbes.
• 扎伊尔（刚果民族共和国的旧称）的基奎特是埃博
 拉病毒上次的暴发地，从其一个拥挤的市场到纽约
 市一条地铁还不到24小时，这么短的距离，对病原
 微生物来说，国界毫无意义。
• 9. Every returning condition marches to the beat of
 a different drum.
• 每种回归疾病的回归步调各有不同。
• 10. Prison and homeless shelters are idea venues for
 TB spread, with confined populations in close area.
• 监狱和无家可归者收容所是结核病蔓延的理想场所，
 因为这些场所把人群禁闭在封闭的空间。

• 11. TB also hitched a ride on the HIV wagon by
  attacking the immunocompromised--- an emerging
  disease thus helping reignite an old one.
• 结核病也搭了HIV 的顺风车，借机攻击免疫力已经
 受损者：一种新病就这样帮助一种旧病复燃。
• 12. The flu virus is a trickster, constantly changing its
  surface antigen, so that our immune system need to
  relearn how to fight it every time it adopts a new
  costume.
• 流感病毒诡计多端，不断变化其表面抗原，这样它
 每换一套新衣，我们的免疫系统就需要重新学习如
 何与之战斗。
• 13. Eternal vigilance or infernal results
• 永不放松警惕，否则就成人间地狱

• 14. The latest, reported in March, involves a migrant
 worker from Georgia, living in a trailer park with
  stagnant water serving as mosquito breeding pools.
• 最近一例是三月份报道的，是一位移民，来自格鲁
 吉亚的一位工人，住在房车营地，那里有滋生蚊虫
 的死水。
• 15. The kind of readiness can keep future headlines free
  of news of worldwide pandemics. The price of liberty
 from infectious disease, as for most freedoms, is eternal
  vigilance.
• 有了这样的充分准备，将来再也见不到世界大流行
 病的新闻报道。和大多数自由一样，免受传染病的
 困扰也需要代价，即永远保持警惕。
